runner_advice.summary: Substantial particulate load. Limit outdoor runs to short, easy aerobic recovery. Shift intervals and tempo workouts to an indoor treadmill.

heat_stress.warning: Moderate Heat & Humidity. High sweat rate. Carry hydration and electrolytes.

tips: Route Choice: Run in shaded tree-dense parks (e.g. botanical gardens or forest reserves). Keep at least 200m away from expressways and industrial corridors.
Respiratory Physiology: Running raises minute ventilation by 10x-15x, bypassing nasal filtration during mouth-breathing.
Post-Run Protocol: Perform a saline nasal rinse immediately after finishing to flush trapped coarse particulates, and shower promptly.
Indoor Alternative: On days with AQI > 100, schedule speed intervals on a gym treadmill and save easy outdoor miles for cleaner days.
